alias: Cameras record only when we're out
description: Frigate records and detects on the Kitchen Display and Bedroom Echo cameras only while Cameron and Paget are both away and guest mode is off; otherwise recording and detection are off. Re-checked when anyone comes or goes, when guest mode changes, at HA start, and whenever Frigate turns a switch back on (a Frigate restart resets them from its config). Inspection mode turns the KS cameras off separately. Added 2026-11-24.

variables.out: {{ not is_state('person.cameron','home') and not is_state('person.paget','home') and is_state('input_boolean.guest_mode','off') }}
